summary: iter29 Batch A — role_title + role_variant + 4-variant dashboard routing + industry-aware OnboardingWizard. Backend: 49/49 tests PASS (iter29: 5/5, iter28: 12/12, iter27: 20/20, iter9: 12/12 — same TestBillingTiers::test_tiers_public deselected as last run). Frontend signup 3-step flow works end-to-end (industry tile picker → role tile picker → details). Dashboard variant routing verified for owner/safety_lead/supervisor/worker (note: worker testid uses industry-specific suffix `worker-dashboard-{slug}`, NOT `worker-dashboard-safe-systems` as listed in spec — see action item below). Settings → Business shows BOTH new cards (settings-industry-card + settings-role-card with settings-role-select Radix combobox). Changing role via Settings UI to food_safety_supervisor → reload /dashboard → safety-lead-dashboard renders. OnboardingWizard step 1 copy is industry-aware ('WHS + Food Safety obligations + council inspection prep'), step 2 button says 'Add your first team member'. End-of-test cleanup confirmed: owner@safetradie.demo reset to industry=trades, role_title=owner, role_variant=owner.

integration_issues.issue: Spec lists data-testid='worker-dashboard-safe-systems' but actual rendered testid is `worker-dashboard-${slug}` from useIndustry() hook (e.g. 'worker-dashboard-trades', '-hospitality', '-transport', '-healthcare', '-retail'). The component itself renders correctly when role_variant='worker'; only the spec wording is off. Either update the spec to match implementation OR add a stable wrapping testid 'worker-dashboard-safe-systems' alongside the per-industry one if cross-industry test stability is required.

issues: Form retains the trades-original labels 'TRADE TYPE' (with default 'Electrician') and 'WORKERS' even when industry=hospitality. The narrative copy at the top adapts ('We'll use this to pre-load relevant WHS + Food Safety obligations + council inspection prep for your hospitality.') but the field label and dropdown options still say 'TRADE TYPE: Electrician'. Should be 'BUSINESS TYPE / VENUE TYPE' for hospitality (e.g. Restaurant / Cafe / Bar) per Part 1 brief. Owner brief acknowledges Batch A may not have full per-industry forms — flag for Batch B.

action_items: Decide on worker dashboard testid: keep dynamic `worker-dashboard-${slug}` (current) and update task spec wording, OR add a stable 'worker-dashboard-safe-systems' testid alongside the dynamic one in /app/frontend/src/pages/dashboards/WorkerDashboard.jsx line 40.
(Batch B candidate) OnboardingWizard form fields ('TRADE TYPE', 'WORKERS') should adapt to industry — currently only the prose copy adapts via INDUSTRY_CONTEXT, not the form labels/options.

(Cleanup) iter9 TestBillingTiers::test_tiers_public is still asserting 6 tiers when current API exposes 8 — same deselect pattern as iter27/iter28. Update that assertion in a future cleanup pass to remove the --deselect.
critical_code_review_comments: RegisterIn schema accepts arbitrary `role_title` strings (only `role_variant` is Literal-validated). This is fine because the dashboard routes purely off role_variant, but `role_title` could be tightened to a Literal union of all known IDs across ROLES_BY_INDUSTRY for stricter input. Low priority.
PATCH /api/auth/me/role accepts any non-empty role_title. Same observation as above — non-blocking.
Dashboard.jsx switch on role_variant (top of file) is clean and predictable; safety_lead/supervisor/worker each map to one dedicated component, default falls through to existing OwnerDashboard.
roles.config.js is single-source-of-truth for both UI tile lists and dashboard variant mapping — solid pattern. VALID_VARIANTS export aligns with the backend Literal in RegisterIn.

WorkerDashboard data-testid is dynamic per industry (`worker-dashboard-${slug}`) — by design supports per-industry visual smoke testing, but breaks generic 'is this a worker view' assertions. Consider adding a static fallback testid (see action item).
